name: listing-search-repo
description: Repository entry point: one command for each task across the API (src/) and the UI (client/).

scripts.setup: bun install && bun install --cwd client && dotnet restore ListingSearch.slnx
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:web:after-api"
scripts.dev:web:after-api: echo Waiting for the API to report ready... && wait-on --interval 500 http-get://127.0.0.1:5001/health/ready && bun run dev:web
scripts.test: concurrently --group --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "bun run test:api" "bun run test:web"
scripts.check: dotnet format ListingSearch.slnx --verify-no-changes && bun run --cwd client check && bun run test:api
